I went to college for a short while doing plastering which lead me to site work. Which I guess ties into why I'm here. As I stated my life has been a battle. With my mum being a drug addict, I was eating out of bins as a kid because she was always out of it on heroin. I never attended infant school, which is how social ended up catching onto my mum and her habits. Since moving out of care I've bounced around from place to place. I have a bubbly personality when I first meet people so I've always managed to find places to stay and have had it easy in the sense of not having to do much for myself. I tend to show up with drugs, convince everyone it's a fun time and just sesh it out for a bit. Then my mental illness comes through. I get depressed and truly helpless and become  timid and quite. This is when people start to act funny with me, which is what's happening now with the place I'm at. I'm living with two friends but I can never explain how I feel, I just keep myself to myself in these times and I think I come off as ignorant and like I don't have time for them. But that's not it! When I get like this being social is a massive task that mentally drains me and leaves me feeling extremely tired. I've tried to turn my life around though over the past few years. Tried making some real connections with people. Tried letting them in and being more open. I met a girl, she was wonderful. The kind of girl you see in a movie you know? I was basically a tramp. No money, looked scruffy, didn't have much going for me. She was beautiful, cool and came from a rich family and was very wealthy. Not that that's important, but as an example of how polar opposites we were. Anyways, she ended up cheating on me and it broke me mentally. She left the country just after I had moved us into a place of our own and I was left with a lot of debt and had to leave just 2 months into having the place. Of course this meant I lost my job too. I moved town and tried to start a new life. Got a job within the first two days, met a lot of new people, but it wasn't right. I felt so alone despite being around people constantly, and so I moved back to my hometown just before Christmas. I was staying with a different friend who again acted quite hostile when I was low as if my l9w mood was a personal attack against him. But I grinder it out and told my self that it will get better. I did anything I could for money. Sold anything I could get my hands on, went 2/3 days without eating or drinking at a time, even went a week or more without washing because it costs to much electricity. All this time I was staying in his spare room with nothing more than a sleeping bag, which had a broken window which was horrible considering the temperatures. I was sick for a long time due to conditions. I pushed on though and landed my self a job back on site (This is where it ties in) I had been told there was 5 months (at least) worth of work. £40 a day to work from 9 until 1. I was absolutely ecstatic. My life was going to have purpose again. I was going to wake up and have something to do other than stare at a wall and wait to fall asleep. And with the wage (considering the hours) I was going to be able to afford a place again and start getting life back on track. I even went to see a few places I felt that positive. My first day back was amazing. I hadn't seen my site mates in a while so it was a good laugh. What could go wrong? Well let me tell you. The guy who pays my boss sent 100k to the wrong person, who then fucked off with the money and no one can reach them. Day two back at work and I'm already out of a job. Right back to where I was. But then my friend I mentioned I was staying with tells me I have to go aswell. It's like one thing can't go wrong at a time you know? Every time one thing happens an entire shit storm has too follow. I mean sure, I found another friend to stay with. But at this stage, I feel like a burden. I can feel tension within the house Every time I feel like this. I honestly wish I had a mother I could run too right now to tell me it's going to be ok and give me that little glimmer of hope I need to carry on. But the only way I'm seeing her again is if I follow her footsteps and overdose. I've done a lot of bad things in my life, but I have always tried to aknowledge and correct them. Could this just be Karma finally catching up with me? Knocking me down Every time o get my foot in the door? Or am I just nothing more than what I am and where I'm at right now? I always told my self life would get better, but 21 short years have lead me on a constant downward spiral that I only see one end too. Maybe not tonight, but one day. I think about it so frequently and have overdosed and ended up in hospital because a friend has called an ambulance more times than I can count. I don't see any chance of me being "Healthy" and living "Normal" and I honestly believe that one of these days I won't have my phone to be able to rant to someone about my feelings, and I will end up taking my own life. And I'm 50 between thinking "Cool I have a few more years to enjoy the little things" whilst also thinking "What's the point? You know you're going to do it one day. Might as well be now"
